title: forecaster.metrics.crps_from_quantiles
---



```python
forecaster.metrics.crps_from_quantiles(y_true, pred_quantiles, quantile_levels)
```

Calculate the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) from quantiles.

The empirical cdf is approximated using linear interpolation
between the predicted quantiles.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name            | Type                                     | Description                                                   | Default    |
|-----------------|------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| y_true          | [float](`float`)                         | The true value of the random variable.                        | _required_ |
| pred_quantiles  | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | The predicted quantile values.                                | _required_ |
| quantile_levels | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) | The quantile levels corresponding to the predicted quantiles. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type             | Description     |
|--------|------------------|-----------------|
|        | [float](`float`) | The CRPS score. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#8162347b .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import numpy as np
from spotforecast2_safe.forecaster.metrics import crps_from_quantiles

y_true = 5.0
pred_quantiles = np.array([4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5, 6.0])
quantile_levels = np.array([0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9])
crps = crps_from_quantiles(y_true, pred_quantiles, quantile_levels)
print(crps >= 0)
```
